Kilowallet 1.0.0 (10) — RC4 publisher candidate

On-chain wallet with Taproot, PSBT signing, coin controls and fee bumping; Kilojoin pools; Ark; on-device Lightning; built-in Tor; encrypted .kab backups and node-move files.

First check the upgrade using synthetic/empty test wallets: wallet identities, receive-address progress, labels, frozen coins and pending transactions must be preserved. Check wallet switching and reopening the app. Report the build number, screen and reproduction steps. Never send recovery words, passwords, keys or backup files.

Kilojoin supports v1–v6. V6 rounds persist across app closure and request a verified creator snapshot on reconnect; snapshots never sign automatically. You must review and sign manually. Completion and conflicting-spend release require six confirmations. Reorgs and failed broadcasts trigger retries. Signed inputs remain reserved while the outcome is unresolved; waiting or restarting does not cancel a signed transaction. There is no continuous iOS background round service or round notification feature.

Lightning uses Tor by default. The optional cross-network bridge in this publisher candidate uses HTTPS through Cloudflare, including when Tor is running. With Tor running, CoinJoin tries the onion relay first and falls back to the public relay through Tor; with Tor off it connects directly. Ark uses a separate operator. Background alerts and Ark renewal depend on iOS scheduling.

Native CI, migration checks, simulator visuals and live empty-wallet engine probes passed. Real-iPhone reliability, funded-channel recovery and live pool completion have not been established by those checks. Use synthetic wallets only during this qualification. Keep secure backups; .kab and node-move files may contain recovery material or live channel state and require protected storage and passwords.

Build 10 fixes incomplete text rendering in wallet creation and Lightning screens, including screen re-entry.
